author: coordinator
intent: Recover signed media row/pixel-offset arrays, signed coordinate pairs and sixteen-byte pixel blocks across production, raster consumption and teardown without changing original behavior.
evidence: Pinned 5D3DF0 allocates twice the height in signed row offsets starting at -width*height with width increments. 5D3980 allocates eight bytes per signed x/y pair and four bytes per signed linear offset; pair fields are sign-extended ten-bit values and offsets are row_offsets[height+y]+x.

Pinned 5D3980 allocates sixteen bytes per raw/expanded block, copies raw blocks and expands sixteen byte pixels in descending destination order. 5D4448 consumes four four-byte rows per block. These are descriptive recovered types, not original debug names.

Preserve allocations, capacities, failure/cleanup ordering, frame swapping, unchecked indexing, bit-pattern sign conversion, all original identities and historical claims. Require native owner comparisons and application compile/link; no original error-path normalization, exactness grant or game acceptance.
